home.guideIntroParagraph1: This guide was created to provide Legends of Titan members with clear, practical and reliable information they can apply directly in the game.
home.guideIntroParagraph2: The goal is not to make topics unnecessarily complicated, but to present the most effective strategies, important mechanics and key points to watch in an organized and easy-to-understand way. This allows both new players and experienced members to benefit from the guide.
home.guideIntroParagraph3: Game updates, individual lineups and different scenarios may cause some strategies to change over time. Treat this guide not as a fixed set of rules, but as a strong foundation and reference resource.
